name: GreyNoise
tagline: Internet noise intelligence that filters mass scanners from real attacks
description: GreyNoise collects and analyzes internet-wide scanner and worm activity so security teams can distinguish background noise from targeted threats. Its API returns IP classification (benign, malicious, unknown), tags, CVEs, first/last-seen timestamps, and context for enrichment, SIEM workflows, and alert triage.

auth.details: API key via key header (e.g. key: YOUR_API_KEY) or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve signup at viz.greynoise.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community free tier: up to 50 searches/week (Community API + Visualizer combined; business email required for API key). Unauthenticated: limited daily lookups (docs show ~10/day).
pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise/commercial plans with higher quotas, RIOT, GNQL, bulk, and historical data — see greynoise.io/pricing

rate_limits: Free Community: 50 searches/week (combined API + Visualizer). Unauthenticated: limited daily IP lookups. Paid tiers: higher/unlimited quotas and Enterprise/GNQL API access — plan-dependent (see greynoise.io/pricing).
use_cases: classify an IP as internet noise vs targeted threat during alert triage
check if an IP is a known benign service (RIOT) before blocking
enrich SIEM alerts with GreyNoise tags and first/last-seen metadata
filter mass scanner traffic from firewall or IDS investigation queues
look up CVEs and tags associated with noisy scanner IPs
